$description: Mission Control Design System — extracted from the Mission Control bento dashboard mockup. A dark-first, monospace terminal aesthetic with a GitHub-inspired neon palette. Dark mode is source-faithful; light mode is a derived GitHub-style professional light theme. Edit values here only — never hand-edit the generated src/index.css or src/generated/tokens.tsx.

primary.$description: Electric blue — the dominant brand color, derived from the dark-mode neon blue (#58a6ff) darkened for light-mode contrast.

accent.$description: Circuit green — derived from the dark-mode status green (#3fb950).

destructive.$description: Alert red — derived from the dark-mode error orange (#f78166).

background.$description: Near-black with a blue tint — the bento dashboard's bg-background in dark mode (hsl 240 10% 3.9%).

card.$description: Slightly elevated card surface — the bento cell bg.

primary.$description: Neon electric blue — the dominant brand color (tech-primary). Used for chart lines, the system name, and active states.

secondary.$description: Slightly lighter than card — used for secondary surfaces and chips.

mutedForeground.$description: tech-muted — the grey used for axis labels and secondary info.

accent.$description: Circuit green — the status/success colour (tech-green). Used for NOMINAL status, SLA pass, and commit heatmap highs.

destructive.$description: Alert amber-red — the error colour (tech-orange). Used for exceptions, 500 bars, and error nodes.

border.$description: Subtle dark border — the bento cell border (hsl 240 3.7% 15.9%).

chart1.$description: Electric blue — primary series (CPU, p95 latency).

sidebar.$description: Darkest surface — sidebar sits behind the bento grid.

sans.$description: Monospace is the sole UI face in this system — every surface in the dashboard uses font-mono. JetBrains Mono for its excellent readability at small sizes and tabular numerals.

serif.$description: Fallback — not actively used in this system.

base.$description: Tight terminal radius. Bento cells apply rounded-2xl (1rem) directly; controls and badges stay sharp at 0.25 rem base.
